entities.title: The VS Code extension
entities.summary: Cyberspace Explorer for VS Code: the explorer's page in a webview, reading a workspace folder's .dev files from disk.
entities.purpose: Lets a developer read and fly through the views of the code they have open, including views not yet committed, without leaving the editor or giving a token to anyone.
boundaries: The page is ../index.html, copied into media/ when packaged; this folder adds only the host: the webview, the workspace's files, the theme and links back into the editor.
Plain JavaScript with no dependencies and no build; src/page.js has no vscode import, so test/page.test.js runs it in Node.
Not published to the Marketplace yet: npm run package builds a .vsix.
